Officially opened in January 2026, this gallery introduces visitors to the rich history and cultural heritage of the Chinese-Indonesian community through modern storytelling, immersive rooms, and engaging multimedia installations. The gallery uses digital projections, interactive installations, and storytelling spaces that make learning about history engaging for visitors of all ages.
• Cultural Acculturation
Discover how Chinese traditions blended with Indonesian culture in food, language, art, festivals, and everyday life.

longDescription:
Tian Fu Gong (天福宫) is a grand Chinese temple located on Riverwalk Island PIK. 

The temple serves as a place of worship for the Tridharma community while also standing as a symbol of harmony and cultural diversity. Positioned alongside Masjid Al-Ikhlas, it reflects the spirit of peaceful coexistence between different faiths in the area.

Known for its impressive traditional Chinese architecture, Tian Fu Gong features intricate carvings, elegant prayer halls, and Indonesia's tallest Jade Emperor (Yu Huang Da Di) statue. Whether visiting for worship, cultural appreciation, or photography, the temple offers a peaceful and memorable experience for visitors.

Tzu Chi Foundation (Yayasan Buddha Tzu Chi Indonesia) is a large spiritual and cultural complex located in the Pantai Indah Kapuk (PIK) area. 

This place covering around 10 hectares and centered around the monumental Jing Si Hall, a grand building inspired by the Tzu Chi headquarters in Hualien, Taiwan. Known for its calm atmosphere, grey stone architecture, and symmetrical design, this destination is one of the most popular places in Jakarta for architecture photography, cultural visits, and quiet reflection. 

Visitors often describe the complex as having a zen, peaceful, and international vibe, similar to temples and cultural centers in Taiwan, China, or Japan.
